messages:
support_lydia: Customer ACME reporting SSE stream frequently truncates mid-event (partial chunk), client immediately reconnects, then receives overlapping content and duplicate billing entries. pcap uploaded to /files/pcaps/2143654321-acme.pcap :warning:
customer_acme_infra: seeing 502/connection reset after ~9-11s of streaming. client-side shows '
  event: message
  data: { ... partial json' then socket closes. on reconnect client gets leftover tokens and double-counts.
eng_runtime_lee: can you attach the raw edge logs + example request headers? rough client curl would help to repro.
support_lydia: uploaded edge-proxy logs: /files/logs/2143654321-edge.log and a minimal curl we used to repro:
```
curl -N -H "Accept: text/event-stream" -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" "https://api.redwood.example/v1/streams?model=rw-long"
```
customer_acme_infra: added a short pcap extract in the channel. small note: they use an intermediary CDN with TLS 1.3 and HTTP/2->HTTP/1.1 conversion at the edge.
sre_morgan: looked at the pcap: I see the server sending chunked SSE then TLS record size drops to tiny fragments, then the proxy sends a TCP RST to upstream at 11.02s. excerpt:
```
11.020s proxy -> upstream: RST, seq=..., ack=...
11.021s client -> proxy: ACK
```
eng_runtime_lee: interesting — does the edge have any window-based flush or an idle timeout that might tear the connection mid-event? also curious about `proxy_buffering` settings and `sendfile` tricks.
support_lydia: proxy config snippet from ACME's vendor: `max_outstanding=64, http2_window=65535, tls_fragmentation=auto, idle_timeout=10s`
customer_acme_infra: idle_timeout=10s matches our observations. we tried raising to 30s and got fewer truncations but not eliminated.
sre_morgan: two hypotheses: (1) the proxy's idle timeout is measured between transmitted records and sees long gaps inside a single SSE event because of large event payloads split across TLS records, it decides connection idle and tears it down; (2) HTTP/2->1.1 conversion causes a buggy frame reassembly under certain TLS fragment sizes leading to RST. both could cause partial segments to reach client.
eng_runtime_lee: actionable repro steps for us to validate locally:
- run a small nginx-based proxy with http2->1.1 conversion and tls fragment size forced small (use test cert)
- stream a ~60KB SSE event that will be split into multiple TLS records with pauses
- capture tcpdump on both sides and compare sequence numbers and TLS record boundaries
Example tcpdump command we used:
```
sudo tcpdump -i any host 10.0.0.5 and port 443 -w /tmp/trace.pcap
```
Also a minimal server to reproduce (node):
```
const http = require('http')
http.createServer((req, res) => {
  res.writeHead(200, {'Content-Type': 'text/event-stream'});
  res.write('event: message\n');
  // chunk the payload with pauses to force TLS fragmentation
  const payload = 'data: ' + 'x'.repeat(60000) + "\n\n";
  let i = 0;
  function sendChunk() {
    if (i >= payload.length) return res.end();
    res.write(payload.slice(i, i+1200));
    i += 1200;
    setTimeout(sendChunk, 80);
  }
  sendChunk();
}).listen(9000);
```
customer_acme_infra: ok will try a local nginx proxy with that node server and small tls fragments tonight. thanks.
sre_morgan: for immediate mitigation: ask customer to increase edge idle timeout and disable aggressive RST-on-window-change if vendor supports it. longer-term we should add a metric to our streaming proxy telemetry: count of mid-event truncations (partial-sse-closed) and last-fragment-seq per connection.
eng_runtime_lee: I can add a lightweight histogram in the runtime that emits `stream.segment_length` and a tag `closed_mid_event=true/false`. also log `last_write_ts` per connection to correlate with edge tear-downs. will open a PR.
support_lydia: assigned to eng_runtime_lee and sre_morgan. I'll notify ACME and ask them to test increased idle timeout, and share any tcpdumps.
customer_acme_infra: thanks — after raising idle to 30s we saw a 70% drop in truncations. we'll share a fresh pcap shortly. :+1:
deploy-bot: deploy started for branch runtime/stream-seg-hist at commit 4f2d9a4
eng_runtime_lee: noted, will watch staging metrics.
sre_morgan: follow-up: if vendor can't disable RST behavior we should document explicit proxy config in our troubleshooting KB (internal). adding to backlog. :memo:
support_lydia: thanks team — keeping thread open until stable. :eyes:
